battle.name: 護國戰爭
battle.theater: 滇南首義與桂黔川湘諸省戰線
battle.brief: 1915年12月25日，雲南都督蔡鍔與唐繼堯宣布雲南獨立，組織護國軍討袁，桂、黔、川、湘、浙、陝、粵、魯各省先後響應，戰事由滇南蔓延至西南與中南。當時雙方皆無制空權，師屬砲兵營的七五公分野砲與輕機槍構成攻守骨幹，砲的射程、彈藥存量與鐵路補給線，決定了護國軍能否攻入川南與湘中。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 1915年12月25日雲南宣布獨立之後，護國戰爭在兩面都自稱中華民國的旗號下展開。北京方面是袁世凱掌權的北洋政府：袁以大總統兼總參謀長的身份坐鎮中南海，陸軍總長段祺瑞掌北洋陸軍，編制以師為主幹，混成旅、旅、團、營為分支，地方另有巡警隊與省軍武裝，參政院、內務部與陸軍部分掌立法、行政與軍令。下詔討滇的北洋軍以曹錕第三師、朱登光第四師等部入川，以王占元第二師與湖北第十一師沿湘鄂線壓迫湖南，砲兵配屬各師砲兵營。滇方則組建護國軍：蔡鍔任總司令，率第一軍出川南；唐繼堯任第三軍軍長兼雲南都督，李根源任川軍總司令（後由熊克武接掌），李烈鈞於1916年2月出任第二軍軍長。1916年5月8日，梁啟超在肇慶主持護國軍軍務院，以撫軍兼政務委員長總攬討袁全局。地方上，貴州唐繼堯、廣西陸榮廷、浙江朱瑞、四川陳宧、湖南譚延闓、陝西陳樹藩、廣東龍濟光、山東張宗昌先後以獨立或自治名義響應，江蘇馮國璋控制下的北洋軍也拒不進兵。孫中山主持的中華革命黨另組中華革命軍東北軍，在山東膠濟鐵路沿線活動；宗社黨與前清遺老在北方策應。護國軍宣稱擁護共和、恢復約法，並未另立國號，各地響應者多以「去袁」為共同目標。
countriesEn: After Yunnan declared independence on 25 December 1915, the National Protection War was fought under two banners that both claimed to be the Republic of China. On the Beijing side stood Yuan Shikai's Beiyang government: Yuan sat in the Zhongnanhai as president and commander in chief, with Duan Qirai as war minister holding the Beiyang army, whose organisation rested on divisions as its trunk, with brigades, mixed brigades, regiments and battalions as branches, and with provincial police forces and local provincial troops outside the regular order of battle. The Senate acting in place of the legislature, the Ministry of the Interior and the War Ministry shared out legislation, administration and military command. The Beiyang armies sent north to suppress Yunnan included Cao Kun's Third Division and Zhu Dengguang's Fourth Division into Sichuan, while Wang Zhan Yuan's Second Division and the Eleventh Division of Hubei pressed along the Hunan-Hubei axis; artillery was allotted to the artillery battalion of every division. On the Yunnan side the National Protection Army was raised: Cai E served as commander in chief and led the First Army into southern Sichuan; Tang Jiyao was commander of the Third Army and governor of Yunnan; Li Genyuan was commander of the Sichuan troops, a post later taken by Xiong Kewu; and Li Liejun became commander of the Second Army in February 1916. On 8 May 1916 Liang Qichao presided over the Military Affairs Council of the National Protection Army at Zhaoqing as pacification commissioner and chairman of the political committee, taking charge of the anti-Yuan campaign as a whole. Across the provinces, Tang Jiyao in Guizhou, Lu Rongting in Guangxi, Zhu Rui in Zhejiang, Chen Yi in Sichuan, Tan Yankai in Hunan, Chen Shufan in Shaanxi, Long Jiguang in Guangdong and Zhang Zongchang in Shandong answered the call in turn, each declaring independence or autonomy, while the Beiyang army under Feng Guozhang in Jiangsu flatly refused to advance against the south. The Chinese Revolutionary Alliance led by Sun Yat-sen separately organised the Northeast Army of the Chinese Revolutionary Army along the Jiaozhi railway in Shandong, and the Zhongshe party together with former Qing loyalists operated in the north. The National Protection Army proclaimed itself the defender of the republic and the restorer of the provisional constitution; it raised no new national title, and most of those who answered did so for the single common purpose of getting rid of Yuan.
people: 蔡鍔是這場戰爭的樞紐。他1913年出任雲南都督，主持雲南歸附共和，1915年11月自北京化裝潛行，經日本與越南返回昆明，抵滇後即密電唐繼堯、李根源策劃起義，12月19日與唐繼堯等通電勸袁世凱取消帝制，12月25日與唐繼堯聯名宣布雲南獨立，被各省公推為護國軍總司令。他堅持只反對帝制而不同時反覆共和，先後婉拒部下提出的擁護他本人為大總統之議，隨後率第一軍出川南，屢攻敘州、瀘州、納溪，肺病日益沉重，1916年3月8日病逝於昆明，靈柩運回湖南邵陽時沿途送行軍民達數十萬人。唐繼堯主持滇軍後方、糧秣與兵員接應，並任護國軍第三軍軍長，後任雲南都督兼陸軍部長。梁啟超是護國軍的理論家與文告起草者，《異哉所謂國體問題者》早已駁斥變更國體，1915年12月23日以護國軍名義發出討袁檄文，1916年5月出任肇慶軍務院撫軍。段祺瑞掌北洋軍權，起初不附袁氏，3月22日以將北洋軍全數移駐河南為要挾，逼袁撤銷帝制；馮國璋控制的江蘇同樣拒不進兵並聯電各省，5月17日的南京會議因各省代表意見分歧而無功而返。袁世凱自籌安會成立起推動稱帝，接受推戴後仍拖延登基，至1916年3月22日下令取消帝制、廢洪憲年號，6月6日上午十時病逝。李純、曹錕等北洋將領主持入川與湘鄂方向作戰，護國軍方面的李烈鈞、熊克武、譚延闓、陸榮廷與革命黨的孫中山、岑春煊，各自分據戰線與活動據點。
peopleEn: Cai E was the hinge of the whole war. Appointed governor of Yunnan in 1913, he had led the province back into the republican camp; in November 1915 he left Beijing in disguise and travelled back to Kunming through Japan and French Indochina, and once in Yunnan he immediately sent secret telegrams to Tang Jiyao and Li Genyuan to plan the rising. On 19 December he and Tang Jiyao telegraphed the nation urging Yuan Shikai to abandon the monarchy, and on 25 December the two of them jointly announced the independence of Yunnan, and the provinces acclaimed Cai E commander in chief of the National Protection Army. He insisted on opposing only the monarchy and not the republic at the same time, and declined in turn the proposals of his own officers to acclaim him as president in his own right. He then led the First Army into southern Sichuan, repeatedly attacking Xuzhou, Luzhou and Luxi, and his tuberculosis worsened until he died in Kunming on 8 March 1916; when his coffin was carried back to Shaoyang in Hunan tens of thousands of soldiers and civilians lined the route to see it off. Tang Jiyao directed the Yunnan rear, supplies and replacements, served as commander of the Third Army and later as governor of Yunnan and minister of war. Liang Qichao was the ideologue and drafter of the movement's proclamations; his essay on the question of national form had already demolished the case for changing the state system, on 23 December 1915 the National Protection Army issued his proclamation against Yuan, and in May 1916 he became pacification commissioner of the Zhaoqing Military Affairs Council. Duan Qirai, who controlled the Beiyang army, refused at first to support Yuan; on 22 March he used the transfer of the entire Beiyang army to Henan as a lever to force the cancellation of the monarchy. Feng Guozhang's Jiangsu likewise refused to send troops and wired the provinces; the Nanjing conference of 17 May ended without result because the provincial delegates disagreed. Yuan Shikai had pushed for the monarchy since the founding of the Preparatory Constitutional Association, and even after accepting the acclamation he postponed his own coronation, until on 22 March 1916 he ordered the monarchy cancelled and the Hongxian era abolished; he died of illness at ten in the morning on 6 June. On the Beiyang side generals such as Li Chun and Cao Kun directed operations into Sichuan and along the Hunan-Hubei axis, while on the other side Li Liejun, Xiong Kewu, Tan Yankai and Lu Rongting, together with Sun Yat-sen and Cen Chunxuan of the revolutionary party, each held their own line or base of operations.
kits: 卡面上的線膛砲，指的是清末至民初陸軍的制式野砲：前裝、線膛、以整裝藥包發射，一八五〇年前後的德國克虜伯七五毫米野砲是它的原型。中國各廠相繼仿製，江南製造總局、漢陽兵工廠、瀋陽東三省兵工廠、山西機器局都造過仿德式七五釐米野砲與山砲，射程約五千公尺；舊式後坐機構使射速只有每分鐘兩三發，砲身配防盾，砲車重逾兩噸，整門砲需十數匹馬牽引，分解與組裝都要人馬數十，警戒展開緩慢。編制上每師設砲兵營，配置野砲約九至十二門，構成師的骨幹火力；軍中配屬的德製與仿製七九二公厘馬克沁重機槍、漢陽造步槍、迫擊砲與手榴彈，組成步砲協同的核心。護國軍的滇軍裝備多為前清與民初接收的舊式槍砲，彈藥以各師庫存和戰場繳獲為主，軍械多經滇越鐵路由海防方向運入，許多砲彈為土法自製，型號與規格參差；北洋軍則倚賴京漢、粵漢鐵路沿線調運，購自歐洲的軍械補充較快。護國軍為節省運力，運輸大量依靠雲南本地的馬匹、騾車與人力挑運，北洋軍在湘鄂、滇川線上使用汽車與鐵路貨車，並大量徵用民車轉運，鐵路沿線的車站、橋樑與哨所因此成為爭奪重點。
kitsEn: The rifled gun on the card is the standard field artillery of the late Qing and early Republican armies: muzzle-loading, rifled, fired with a single packed cartridge, modelled on the German Krupp 75 mm field gun of about 1850. Chinese arsenals copied it in turn; the Jiangnan Arsenal, the Hanyang Arsenal, the Northeast Arsenal at Shenyang and the Shanxi Machinery Bureau all produced German-pattern 7.5 cm field and mountain guns with a range of roughly five thousand metres. The old recoil mechanism limited the rate of fire to two or three rounds a minute, the guns carried shields, the carriage weighed over two tons, and a complete gun needed a dozen or more horses to pull it, so breaking down and reassembling it demanded dozens of men and animals and the battery took a long time to unlimber and deploy. Organisationally each division had an artillery battalion with roughly nine to twelve field guns, which formed the skeleton of the division's firepower; the German and copied 7.92 mm Maxim heavy machine guns, Hanyang-made rifles, mortars and hand grenades allotted to the troops formed the core of the infantry-artillery combination. The Yunnan army of the National Protection Army was largely equipped with old rifles and guns taken over from the late Qing and early Republican period, and its ammunition came mainly from divisional stores and battlefield capture; weapons and stores came in along the Yunnan-Indochina railway from the Haiphong direction, and many shells were made locally in the crudest fashion, with types and specifications that varied widely. The Beiyang armies relied on the Beijing-Hankou and Canton-Hankou railway lines for their supply and received replacements of European purchased equipment more quickly. To save transport effort the National Protection Army used large numbers of local Yunnan packhorses, mule carts and human porters, while the Beiyang army used lorries and railway wagons on the Hunan-Hubei and Yunnan-Sichuan fronts and requisitioned civilian carts on a large scale, which made stations, bridges and picket posts along the railways the points both sides fought over.
tactics: 雙方的打法都受制於一九一五年前後的技術條件。滇軍在昆明宣布戒嚴、封鎖電台、遣散外籍顧問並清查槍械，以護國之名換掉擁帝的旗號，集結待命多在昆明與滇南各縣，機動作戰強調輕裝、分散與晝間宿營。出川一路取敘州、瀘州、納溪方向，在長江上游的縱深地帶與北洋軍反覆拉鋸；唐繼堯、陸榮廷聯軍沿湘桂線北上，攻入湖南衡陽、永州一帶，再圖江華、湘潭方向；李烈鈞第二軍自江西出發，指向湖北與江西。砲兵運用上，護國軍多在山嶽與村莊掩體內架設野砲，以曲射的迫擊砲壓制對方陣地，再以步兵在機槍掩護下逐點攻取；北洋軍則憑藉制式野砲與充裕彈藥，在正面以大射界封鎖通往城池的道路，使護國軍步兵難以接近，並利用鐵路與汽車把預備隊迅速調向前線。補給是護國軍的弱點：糧秣靠滇越鐵路與雲南民屯，彈藥多靠繳獲，一旦離開滇黔桂基地便迅速枯竭；北洋軍雖有鐵路運力，但前線拉得過長，徵發與轉運的效率不高，後方軍心與糧餉同樣吃緊。
tacticsEn: The fighting methods of both sides were constrained by the technology of the mid-1910s. In Kunming the Yunnan army declared martial law, sealed the telegraph offices, dismissed foreign advisers and took stock of arms and ammunition, swapping the flag of supporting the monarchy for the banner of protecting the republic; the units assembled and waited mostly in Kunming and in the counties of southern Yunnan, and their operational thinking stressed light equipment, dispersion and billeting by day. The column entering Sichuan took the line of Xuzhou, Luzhou and Luxi and fought the Beiyang army back and forth in the deep country along the upper Yangtze; the allied armies of Tang Jiyao and Lu Rongting advanced north along the Hunan-Guangxi axis, entered Hunan around Hengyang and Yongzhou, and then aimed at Jianghua and Xiangtan; the Second Army under Li Liejun set out from Jiangxi with Hubei and Jiangxi in view. In the employment of artillery the National Protection Army usually emplaced its field guns in positions masked by hills and village enclosures, used the curved trajectory of mortars to batter enemy positions, and then took the ground point by point with infantry under machine-gun cover. The Beiyang army, relying on standardised field guns and ample ammunition, locked the roads leading to the walled towns with wide arcs of fire on the front, making it hard for the attacking infantry of the National Protection Army to come close, and moved reserves rapidly to the front by rail and motor lorries. Supply was the weakness of the National Protection Army: grain came from the Yunnan-Indochina railway and from the villages of Yunnan, ammunition largely from capture, and once the armies left the Yunnan-Guizhou-Guangxi base their stocks ran out quickly. The Beiyang army had the railway to draw on, but its front was stretched too far, requisition and transport were inefficient, and the morale and pay of the rear areas were under strain as well.
data: 幾組可核對的數字可以標出這場戰爭的規模。帝制籌備自1915年12月12日袁世凱接受推戴起，到1916年3月22日下令取消、3月23日廢洪憲年號，前後一百零二天。護國軍自雲南宣布獨立到袁世凱病逝，前後約一百九十天，戰線自滇南擴張到滇、黔、桂、川、湘、浙、陝、粵、魯九省。雲南常備陸軍約兩個師，加地方團練與新募之眾，護國軍用於川南與湘中的總兵力大致在數萬之數；北洋方面入川部隊至少三個師，湘鄂方向另有數個師，雙方在川南一度形成數倍兵力於一線的對峙。火炮方面，制式七五公分野砲射程約五千公尺，實際支撐點多在二千至三千公尺之間，攻守雙方都得先算彈藥存量。滇越鐵路昆明至海防段約八百五十餘公里，是護國軍僅有的重運輸通道；北洋軍所用的京漢、粵漢兩線則貫穿主要戰場。傷亡數字在當時的通電、戰報與私人回憶中說法不一，可以確定的是川南與湘中兩線反覆攻守之下，雙方戰傷與失散總數以數千計，而遠征、斷糧與疾病造成的非戰減員尤為顯著，冬季川南山地作戰中尤甚。
dataEn: A few checkable figures mark the scale of this war. The monarchy was prepared for from 12 December 1915, when Yuan Shikai accepted the acclamation, until 22 March 1916, when he ordered it cancelled and on 23 March abolished the Hongxian era; one hundred and two days in all. From the declaration of independence in Yunnan to the death of Yuan Shikai ran some one hundred and ninety days, and the line of war spread from southern Yunnan across nine provinces: Yunnan, Guizhou, Guangxi, Sichuan, Hunan, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Guangdong and Shandong. Yunnan's standing army was about two divisions, and with the local militia and newly recruited men the total National Protection Army strength committed in southern Sichuan and central Hunan was on the order of tens of thousands; on the Beiyang side at least three divisions entered Sichuan with several more on the Hunan-Hubei axis, and for a time the two sides faced each other on the southern Sichuan front with a several-fold difference in numbers. As for artillery, the standard 7.5 cm field gun had a range of about five thousand metres, while the actual supporting positions were usually two to three thousand metres apart, so both sides had to work out their remaining ammunition before committing. The Yunnan-Indochina railway, some eight hundred and fifty kilometres from Kunming to Haiphong, was the only heavy transport artery the National Protection Army possessed; the Beijing-Hankou and Canton-Hankou lines used by the Beiyang armies ran through the main battlefields. Casualty figures differ between the telegrams, battle reports and private memoirs of the time, but it is certain that in the repeated fighting on the southern Sichuan and central Hunan lines both sides suffered casualties and missing men numbering in the thousands, and that non-battle losses from over-march, hunger and disease were especially severe, particularly in the winter fighting in the mountains of southern Sichuan.
cause: 起因是袁世凱要在共和體制之外另立一家。他主政後於1915年接受了日本提出的《二十一條》大部分要求，輿論普遍認為政府屈辱；同年八月，美籍憲法顧問古德諾的《共和與君主論》與楊度等組織的籌安會，又為變更國體提供理論與輿論。參政院代行立法院選出的一千九百餘名國民代表，經幕後操縱一致推戴君主立憲，袁於12月12日接受推戴、12月31日改元洪憲，把大總統府所在的宮殿改稱新華宮，廣封各省軍政要員爵位，並預定日後由總統傳位於皇太子。制度上的驟變同時觸動數方不滿：北洋軍內部段祺瑞、馮國璋等握兵者不願為帝制陪葬；湘、贛、滇、黔一帶知識界與新軍對舊朝名分的復辟仍存戒心；地方督軍如陸榮廷、陳宧等要的是擴權與自保；蔡鍔在滇推行改革與整軍，往來於北京政界，深知帝制一旦成立，共和只剩空名。於是蔡鍔在11月離京南下，與梁啟超策劃，聯絡雲南、廣西、貴州等處，於12月25日起兵，而日本當局為維護在華利益轉而支持革命黨與南方勢力，資金與槍械的外部援助使起兵有了物質基礎。
causeEn: The cause lay in Yuan Shikai's determination to set up a house of his own outside the republican system. After taking power he had accepted most of the Japanese Twenty-One Demands in 1915, and public opinion broadly held the government humiliated; in August of the same year the constitutional adviser Goodnow's essay on republic and monarchy and the Preparatory Constitutional Association formed by Yang Du and others supplied both a theory and a public opinion for changing the form of the state. The nineteen hundred odd national representatives elected to the Senate acting in place of the legislature, manipulated behind the scenes, unanimously endorsed a constitutional monarchy. Yuan accepted their acclamation on 12 December, changed the era to Hongxian on 31 December, renamed the presidential palace the New Flower Palace, conferred ranks of nobility on military and civil officials across the provinces, and fixed in advance that the presidency should pass to a crown prince. Such a sudden change in institutions offended several parties at once. Within the Beiyang army, commanders like Duan Qirai and Feng Guozhang who held real troops were unwilling to be buried alongside the monarchy. In Hunan, Jiangxi, Yunnan and Guizhou, intellectuals and the new-army men still watched for any restoration of the old dynastic name. Provincial governors such as Lu Rongting and Chen Yi wanted a wider hand and security for themselves. Cai E, who had carried out reform and reorganisation in Yunnan and moved in the political circles of Beijing, understood perfectly that once the monarchy was established the republic would be an empty name. He therefore left the capital for the south in November, planned with Liang Qichao, made contact with Yunnan, Guangxi and Guizhou, and raised the revolt on 25 December; and the Japanese government, anxious to protect its own interests in China, turned to support the revolutionaries and the southern forces, so that money and arms from outside gave the rising a material base.
impact: 帝制的夭折改變了民國初年的政治走向。袁世凱一手籌建的洪憲帝制僅存一百零二天便隨本人病逝而崩解，此後中國再未出現成功稱帝的政權，帝制作為合法選項在政治上被徹底關上。但護國的成功並未帶來共和的鞏固：護國軍各路在勝利之後旋即分裂，孫中山與岑春煊、孫中山與梁啟超先後在黨派路線上決裂，中華革命黨一分為數，中央權威虛化，北洋軍系與地方軍系各自盤據，護國戰爭之後緊接着的是1916年7月湖口之戰、1917年張勳復辟、護法運動與直皖戰爭，軍閥政治由此開端。就軍隊而言，護國軍的骨幹日後成為護法軍與國民革命軍的來源，李烈鈞、熊克武、朱培德、譚延闓分別擔任南方軍隊的軍事領導，滇黔系的將領也長期掌握兩廣與西南。青年學生大批投入運動，報刊大量刊載反對帝制的言論，知識界反袁反專權的態度連成一氣，新文化運動的勢頭隨之上升，護國的旗號在日後的反帝與反專制論述中被反覆引用。
impactEn: The miscarriage of the monarchy reshaped the political direction of the early Republic. The Hongxian monarchy built by Yuan Shikai lasted only one hundred and two days and collapsed with his own death; no regime that successfully assumed the imperial title would ever appear in China again, and the monarchy was closed off completely as a legitimate option in politics. But the success of the National Protection movement did not bring a consolidated republic. The armies of the National Protection Army split up soon after their victory; Sun Yat-sen fell out first with Cen Chunxuan and then with Liang Qichao over party line; the Chinese Revolutionary Alliance split into several factions; central authority hollowed out, with the Beiyang clique and the regional armies each entrenching themselves. After the National Protection War came the Battle of Hukou in July 1916, Zhang Xun's restoration in 1917, the Constitutional Protection movement and the Zhili-Anhui War, and the era of warlord politics began. As for the forces themselves, the cadre of the National Protection Army later supplied the Constitutional Protection armies and the National Revolutionary Army; Li Liejun, Xiong Kewu, Zhu Peide and Tan Yankai each led southern formations, while commanders from the Yunnan and Guizhou factions long held the two Guangxi and southwest provinces. Students threw themselves into the movement in large numbers, the press carried a great deal of anti-monarchical writing, and the intellectual mood uniting opposition to Yuan and to autocratic rule strengthened, carrying the New Culture Movement forward with it; the banner of protecting the republic was cited again and again in later anti-imperial and anti-despot discourse.
result: 1916年3月22日袁世凱下令取消帝制、廢止洪憲年號，但滇軍仍以袁退位為目標，不肯罷兵。袁在5月同意商議退位，卻因善後與北洋內部的權力安排遷延不決，5月17日召開的南京會議因各省代表各懷心思而無結果。6月6日上午袁世凱病逝，護國軍同日通電宣稱共和復辟；北洋方面，副總統黎元洪於3月1日接任大總統，段祺瑞出任國務總理，主政於北京。護國軍主帥蔡鍔早在3月8日病逝於昆明，遺命所部以完成共和為己任；6月後滇軍主力回滇，川軍由熊克武收拾，第二軍李烈鈞於7月在湖口對北洋軍作戰失利，江西重新被平定，護國戰爭至此以南方失利、帝制失敗而收場，戰事延續到8月才告完全結束。護國軍各部陸續復員解散，孫中山隨後在廣州成立護法軍政府，把護國的未竟事業轉為護法的長期對抗；而這場戰爭留下的真正結果，是一個帝制崩解而共和未竟的民國，以及此後二十餘年軍閥割據的開端。
resultEn: On 22 March 1916 Yuan Shikai ordered the monarchy cancelled and the Hongxian era abolished, but the Yunnan army kept its aim of driving Yuan out of office and refused to stand down. In May Yuan agreed to discuss his resignation, but the matter dragged on because of the settlement arrangements and the power struggle inside the Beiyang camp, and the Nanjing conference of 17 May ended without result because the provincial delegates each had their own designs. Yuan Shikai died of illness on the morning of 6 June, and the National Protection Army telegraphed the same day that the republic had been restored. On the Beiyang side the vice president Li Yuanhong had taken over as president on 1 March and Duan Qirai became premier, governing from Beijing. The commander in chief of the National Protection Army, Cai E, had died in Kunming as early as 8 March, leaving his troops the instruction to complete the cause of the republic. After June the main body of the Yunnan army went home, the Sichuan troops were gathered in by Xiong Kewu, and the Second Army under Li Liejun was defeated by the Beiyang army at Hukou in July, after which Jiangxi was pacified once more. The National Protection War thus closed with defeat for the south and for the monarchy, the fighting running on until August before it was completely over. The units of the National Protection Army were demobilized and dissolved one after another; Sun Yat-sen then set up the Constitutional Protection government in Guangzhou, converting the unfinished cause of the National Protection into a long contest of Constitutional Protection. The real result of this war was a republic whose monarchy had collapsed while the republic itself remained unconsolidated, and the opening of more than twenty years of warlord separatism.
